show.description: The Hero, who has been passionate about cooking since childhood, dreams of becoming a great chef despite growing up in poverty. He believes all he needs is a chance to showcase his talent. An unexpected twist enters his life with the Royal Hotel. Will Master Chef, who works there, be in a position to give this new comer a chance? Who will emerge as the winner in this game among the chefs?
